answer: A workable design: force a unique proof-of-place stamp per epoch that cannot be replayed by siblings. Link analysis on reused seeds marks the whole set. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, cluster rewards are paid once, not per address. The crystal of work and the saffron of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a raven to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
